caption: The drawing depicts a single human figure clothed in blue and purple garments, with the outer mantle in blue and the inner dress in a purple shade. The figure's skin is a pale cream color, and the hair is black, styled to one side. A red crown or garland rests on the figure’s head, and a golden halo made of radiating lines surrounds the head. The face is detailed with black eyebrows, eyes, and a small mouth, and cheeks are tinted with a subtle reddish blush. The figure is holding a white and red circular object decorated with red circular patterns and gold dots; it surrounds a grey bird, which is positioned at the center of the torso. The background is a light beige or tan color and is framed by a thick black border. Two vertical red drapes trimmed in black hang on either side of the head, suggesting a curtained backdrop. The entire drawing occupies the central portion of a cream-colored paper, with the number “11” printed at the bottom left corner outside the black frame.
title: Retabla of Holy Ghost
